text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: At last—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: At last—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: It's finally here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is right before my eyes!
I can't just run away from it anymore~!

"For a Classic Class Umamusume,
the grandest stage is the 'Classic Triple Crown.'"
Of course, it was a massive event that Mejiro Palmer couldn't ignore either, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think as my bestie?
Should I enter after all? ...Like, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wanna enter together? We are from the same class, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I'm sitting this one out. I decided to stick to sprint races☆ Why don't you run in it, Palmer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see...
Are you on team 'enter the race', or team 'sit this one out', Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa-hoh, playing it like that, are we...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what to do...
Thinking normally, it's gotta be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I should run, right?
Yeah, for a Mejiro Umamusume, aiming for the Triple Crown is practically good manners.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What happens if I crash and burn, though?
They might call me a disgrace to the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, let's keep it simpler.
I'm aiming to be a Palmer who isn't just a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Putting the Mejiro name aside, I need to think
about what I should do. Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the Classic Triple Crown really is
something you gotta take seriously, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, maybe it really is best for me to run.
I'm sure it'll be for my own good—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No, but really? Will it really help me even if it's not a proper match skill-wise?
Won't it just be a harsh dose of reality...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, optimism! 
I wanna do more positive thinking!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I don't really recall things ever going well
just by being optimistic. After all, she wasn't the kind of girl
who could pull through on raw talent alone.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, BFF, I panicked!
Where is the exit!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I mean...
aren't you overthinking this, Pamachin?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just go with your feelings☆
Whether you wanna run or you don't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, from the heart...?
My feelings, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "That's what I'm worst at. I've always prioritized what other people want from me. Trainer...?"
choice_data_list: Even if it's tough for you, decide for yourself.
Even if it's tough for you, make sure to decide for yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's with that serious look...?
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: Because that's what "living true to yourself" means.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Living... true to myself...
The very first goal I ever set...

I decided to watch over her for now. What she wants to do
is something she must explore, understand, and decide for herself.
Unless I could do that, I felt like Mejiro Palmer would never be able to take a step toward becoming who she wants to be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I get it now!
I have to decide for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, first I need to know
how I truly feel deep down inside.
Hmmm..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... This is brutal...!
But I'll do it. Since I'm doing it, make sure you make it worth it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Give me a second!
I'm gonna think for real, just gimme a bit...!
Mejiro Palmer walked away, her ears twitching as she went.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(What do I want~? What do I want~?
What is it that I want to do...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, this is so heavy! I wanna just toss it!
...But I don't wanna ignore it either.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(I don't want to be laughed at. I want to smile.
Admiration, compulsion, responsibility, goals...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: (I am... I will—!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Besties!
Do you understand my feelings now...!
A few days later, Mejiro Palmer called Daitaku Helios and me over and said that.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, then my bestie!
Lay down your declaration for us, plz~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! As for whether I wanna run
in the Classic Triple Crown or not!
How I really feel is—!!
For a brief moment, the wind ceased. And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at aaaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh, saying you don't know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't get it, I just don't get it!
I have no idea, my thoughts are a total mess,
and wanting to enter and being scared are all jumbled up~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, since I've always been lacking,
I've lived my whole life keeping my head down
just trying not to bother anyone."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Even if you suddenly tell me to express myself and speak my mind, how the heck am I supposed to just decide 'This is it!' out of nowhere?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... This is how I truly feel!!

"It sounded like a child's raw, emotional
cry. And hearing her response..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, ahahaha! Love it,
love it! Cluelessness is the best, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, like, who cares if you get it or not?
Isn't that kinda pointless? In the end, we're all about the vibes♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Vibes... vibes, huh...
That's true. Yeah, if you put it as just
feeling it, then that's exactly right.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you don't know, you know?
Isn't it fine not knowing? There are other ways to decide anyway!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What kind of method?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, my mood at the time☆
When the race gets closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Mood! At that moment! The Classic Triple Crown!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe just go with the vibe and how ya feel.
And then, if there's no way you can run...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should send an apology sticker♪
Like two or three of 'em★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A sorry sticker...! But Trainer,
wouldn't that be super annoying...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I knew it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeh, you too, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: You can't run a good race if your heart isn't in it.

text_block_list.text: Whether it's a mood or just a whim, letting Mejiro Palmer do as she pleases. That is—

I felt that this was her true Classic road.
A path she is running for the first time by her own will...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, understood. Then once the race gets closer, I'll discuss it as things come up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: So, basically if the vibe fits, I'm participating, right?

And so, our policy for the Classic Triple Crown
was decided: "Enter if you feel like it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's so sloppy... Was I
always this kind of person? But still--

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Free—and it can just be what I like.
I see... What I like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—!? What's this?
What is this... pounding in my chest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I feel so totally alive!
Man, this is crazy...
I'm getting absolute chills...!
